scripts.build: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py verify
scripts.release:preflight: npm run lint:precommit && npm run test:py:extended && npm run test:frontend:unit && npm run build:portable-exe:prepare && npm run test:frontend:packaged && npm run test:frontend:packaged:admin-startup && npm run test:frontend:packaged:admin-active-run && npm run test:frontend:packaged:sync-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:update-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:orphan-reclaim-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:browser-job-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:desktop-lifecycle-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:active-task-close-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:task-abort-schedule-rehearsal && npm run test:frontend:packaged:first-run && npm run test:frontend:packaged:jobs-pipeline && npm run probe:desktop:startup:jobs:cold
scripts.test:frontend:packaged:task-abort-schedu: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --open-path admin.html --node-smoke-script tests/frontend/packaged-desktop-smoke.task-abort-schedule.mjs --runtime-timeout 60 --playwright-timeout 240
scripts.test:frontend:packaged:first-run: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --open-path desktop-probe.html --node-smoke-script tests/frontend/packaged-desktop-smoke.first-run-jobs.mjs --runtime-timeout 60 --playwright-timeout 240
scripts.test:frontend:packaged:admin-startup: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --open-path admin.html --node-smoke-script tests/frontend/packaged-desktop-smoke.admin-startup.mjs --playwright-timeout 120
scripts.test:frontend:packaged:admin-active-run: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --open-path admin.html --node-smoke-script tests/frontend/packaged-desktop-smoke.admin-active-run.mjs --runtime-timeout 60 --playwright-timeout 180
scripts.test:frontend:packaged:fetch-evidence: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --open-path admin.html --node-smoke-script tests/frontend/packaged-desktop-smoke.fetch-evidence.mjs --playwright-timeout 300
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:jobs:cold: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-mode cold --open-path jobs.html --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:jobs:pair: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/run_startup_probe_pair.py --open-path jobs.html --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:jobs:warm: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-mode warm --open-path jobs.html --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:admin:cold: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-record-only --profile-mode cold --open-path admin.html --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:admin:pair: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/run_startup_probe_pair.py --open-path admin.html --profile-record-only --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:admin:warm: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-record-only --profile-mode warm --open-path admin.html --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.test:py: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q -m "not slow and not packaging and not release" --color=no --basetemp=.tmp/pytest/basetemp
scripts.test:py:linux: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q -m "not slow and not packaging and not release and not windows" --color=no --basetemp=.tmp/pytest/basetemp
scripts.test:py:extended: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q --color=no --basetemp=.tmp/pytest/basetemp
scripts.test:py:timing: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q --durations=25 --durations-min=0.2 --color=no --basetemp=.tmp/pytest/basetemp
scripts.test:py:cov: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q -m "not slow" --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing --color=no
scripts.perf:discovery:quick: npm run check:python-version && python src/discovery_sanity_benchmark.py --preset quick --timeout 10 --top 5 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-discovery-quick
scripts.perf:discovery:capped: npm run check:python-version && python src/discovery_sanity_benchmark.py --preset capped --timeout 30 --top 10 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-discovery-capped
scripts.perf:discovery:capped-provider: npm run check:python-version && python src/discovery_sanity_benchmark.py --preset capped-provider --timeout 30 --top 10 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-discovery-capped-provider
scripts.perf:discovery:capped-gamedevmap: npm run check:python-version && python src/discovery_sanity_benchmark.py --preset capped-gamedevmap --timeout 30 --top 10 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-discovery-capped-gamedevmap
scripts.perf:fetch:smoke: npm run check:python-version && python src/fetch_incremental_sanity_benchmark.py --group smoke --timeout 30 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-fetch-smoke
scripts.perf:fetch:provider-api: npm run check:python-version && python src/fetch_incremental_sanity_benchmark.py --group provider-api --timeout 30 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-fetch-provider-api
scripts.perf:fetch:static-detail: npm run check:python-version && python src/fetch_incremental_sanity_benchmark.py --group static-detail --timeout 30 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-fetch-static-detail
scripts.perf:fetch:static-outliers: npm run check:python-version && python src/fetch_incremental_sanity_benchmark.py --group static-outliers --timeout 30 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-fetch-static-outliers
scripts.perf:fetch:mixed: npm run check:python-version && python src/fetch_incremental_sanity_benchmark.py --group mixed --timeout 30 --output-dir _out/perf-sanity-fetch-mixed
